summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an ordinary share buyback executed on 20 April 2026. It purchased 429,985 ordinary shares from JP Morgan Securities plc on the London Stock Exchange at an average price of £11.1540 per share (range £11.0950–£11.2350). The repurchased shares will be cancelled, reducing share count to 2,523,288,513. This is a routine capital-return program authorized at the 2025 AGM, not a special situation such as an issuer tender offer (which would be an odd-lot or fixed-price offer). No premium, structural complexity, or regulatory clock is present.
